title: Reused ReadIndex context released by a heartbeat acknowledgement produced for the earlier request
cause: readOnly.advance now frees released requests, so a caller context can be registered again in the same leader term, while recvAck matches heartbeat responses only by context; a response produced for the earlier registration completes the new one.
trigger: Release ctx with one ack while another follower's ack is delayed; reuse the same ctx for a new read at the same leader; deliver the delayed ack (optionally after a newer-term leader committed).
consequence: The leader releases the read without any acknowledgement generated after its registration; with a newer-term commit in between, the ReadState index is below an entry committed before the read was issued (stale linearizable read).
premises: The application reuses a ReadIndex context after the previous request with that context completed (read_only.go:19-23 leaves the context to the caller).
A heartbeat response for the earlier request is delayed past the re-registration.
For a stale read: a newer-term leader commits before the reused request while the old leader has not stepped down (CheckQuorum optional).
